hypotheses.Z1_residual_telescope_is_exact: Initial embedding, repeated embedding, attention writes, and MLP writes reconstruct every Layer-4 mixed-state delta within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.Z2_integrated_current_value_recomposes: Analytic Gauss-Legendre integration of the RMSNorm/current-value Jacobian reconstructs every current-value delta within 1e-4 relative error.
hypotheses.Z3_integrated_route_recomposes: The integrated component writes reconstruct the frozen-route current-value attention delta within 1e-4 relative error.
hypotheses.Z4_learned_writes_beat_embedding_paths: The absolute downstream target projection of all Layer-0–3 attention/MLP write terms exceeds all initial/repeated embedding terms on both corpora.
hypotheses.Z5_four_components_dominate_locally: The four largest per-example absolute local component projections carry at least 75% of total absolute component projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.Z6_component_profile_transfers_ood: FineWeb and TinyStories median absolute local component profiles have cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.Z7_later_blocks_dominate_earlier_blocks: Layer-2–3 attention/MLP terms have larger absolute downstream target projection than Layer-0–1 terms on both corpora.
hypotheses.Z8_current_value_route_is_downstream_non: The all-component current-value route patch reaches at least 0.05 downstream target projection on both corpora.
